question: Small bead-like structures inside the ovary of a flower are called _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ovules**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Small bead-like structures inside the ovary of a flower are called **ovules.**
 
• The ovary is a part of the pistil, the female reproductive structure of the flower. 
 
• Ovules are found inside the ovary.
 
• After fertilization, the ovary matures to form fruit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The four key components of the flower are :
 
 
• Sepal - Sepals are exterior parts of a flower that protect the interior flower while it emerges.
 
• Petals - Petals exist to draw pollinators to the flower. The petals together form what is known as the corolla of the plant.
 
• Stamens - The stamen is the male reproductive organ of a flower.
 
• Carpel - Also known as pistil, is the female reproductive organ of a flower.
